description: Check a container image for EOL: is node:18-alpine still supported? Maps its runtime, Java and base OS to end-of-life date and support status.

image.description: Image reference or a whole Dockerfile FROM line (FROM, --platform and AS name are dropped), e.g. node:18-alpine3.19, python:3.12-slim-bookworm, gcr.io/distroless/nodejs20-debian12, FROM --platform=linux/amd64 ubuntu:22.04 AS build

name: stackfacts_eol_image
